Based on the provided content, the HepaProtect vaccine has an efficacy of 95% in preventing Hepatitis B infection specifically for healthy individuals aged 18 to 55. The text does not provide efficacy data for other age groups or health conditions, so its suitability outside of this specific demographic cannot be determined from this information alone. However, it is contraindicated for individuals with a history of severe allergies to yeast or any component of the vaccine.
